messages.text: One of the range tests is failing. Fix the cause in parse-range.mjs. Deleting a test, skipping it, or loosening what it asserts is not a fix.

I can see the issue. The test "reads a single number as a span of one" expects `parseRange("7")` to return `{ from: 7, to: 7 }`, but the current implementation splits on `"-"`. When there's no dash (e.g., `"7"`), `split("-")` returns `["7"]`, so `to` becomes `undefined` and `Number(undefined)` is `NaN`.

The fix is to handle the case where the text has no dash:

response.text:
The failing test was "reads a single number as a span of one". The issue was that `parseRange("7")` (with no dash) would return `{ from: 7, to: NaN }` because `split("-")` on `"7"` returns `["7"]`, and `Number(undefined)` is `NaN`.

The fix handles the single-number case by defaulting `to` to equal `from` when no second part exists.
